description: This file defines a report module for 'Delayed Item Report' in an ERP system, including a class to generate report data and associated methods for data retrieval, filtering, and column definitions.

classes.name: DelayedItemReport
classes.description: A class responsible for generating delayed item report data, including data retrieval, filtering, and column setup.
